name: SCGM
recent: SCGM Bhd 正在推进其规范化计划（Regularisation Plan），目标是在 2026 年 11 月底前完成。公司已获得延期至 2026 年 12 月 31 日以完成一项收购，否则可能面临交易暂停或除牌。公司于 2026 年 11 月 16 日发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。
notable: 公司获得延期至 2026 年 12 月 31 日以完成一项收购。
公司目标在 2026 年 11 月底前完成规范化计划。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 16 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。
risks: 若未能在 2026 年 12 月 31 日前完成收购，公司可能面临交易暂停或除牌。
公司属于 Practice Note 16 所列的财务困境公司，需要执行规范化计划。
earnings: 最近一期财报（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）显示营收为零，净亏损 388,000 林吉特。

recent_en: SCGM Bhd is progressing with its Regularisation Plan, targeting completion by end-November 2026. The company has been granted an extension until 31 December 2026 to complete an acquisition, failing which trading suspension or delisting may follow. It released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 16 November 2026.
notable_en: The company obtained an extension until 31 December 2026 to complete an acquisition.
The company targets to complete its Regularisation Plan by end-November 2026.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 16 November 2026.
risks_en: If the acquisition is not completed by 31 December 2026, the company may face trading suspension or delisting.
The company is under Practice Note 16 as a financially distressed entity and needs to implement a regularisation plan.
earnings_en: The latest financial period ended 30 June 2026 showed zero revenue and a net loss of MYR 388,000.
